title: Driver Quality Bulletin: Rating at the Latest Review and the Lapse Allowance of a Document Hold
content:
Under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product, the rating a Wayfare driver showed at the latest rating review bears on the lapse allowance days of a document hold, meaning the calendar days that hold may run from its hold start date before it ends in deactivation for document lapse.

**Standard.** When the rating at the latest rating review on the standing record is at least 4.90, the lapse allowance days gain 8 days; when it is at least 4.80 but below 4.90, they gain 4 days; when it is below 4.80, they gain none. Ratings are compared at two decimal places as recorded.

| Rating at the latest rating review | Days gained |
|---|---|
| 4.90 or higher | 8 |
| 4.80 to 4.89 | 4 |
| 4.79 or lower | 0 |

**Which rating.** The rating recorded at the most recent rating review entry on the driver's standing record, as recorded, with no further rounding.

**Boundary readings (hypothetical).**
- Latest review rating 4.90: gains 8. Latest review rating 4.89: gains 4.
- Latest review rating 4.80: gains 4. Latest review rating 4.79: gains none.
- An earlier review at 4.95 followed by a latest review at 4.85: the latest review decides, so the hold gains 4.
